items.prompt: True or false: It is impossible to roll a 7 on an ordinary 1 to 6 dice.
hints: What numbers are on a dice?
items.explanation: An ordinary dice only has the numbers 1 to 6, so 7 can never come up.

items.prompt: True or false: A bag has 1 red counter and 9 blue counters. It is certain that you pick a red one.
hints: How many red counters are there?
items.explanation: There is only 1 red out of 10, so picking red is unlikely. It is not certain.
